assumptions: Full and leave-one-out geometry use sorted stable view IDs; acquisition-order trace is execution provenance only.
Image and mask adapters preserve original content; no cross-view truth attribution.
Native DLL calls have an OS-enforced subprocess deadline; Python preparation and raster work use bounded loops and cooperative deadline/cancellation checks.
No symmetry, image deletion, regeneration, camera estimation or source replacement is performed.
Only static orthographic silhouette consistency is measured; hidden concavities, topology, anatomy, appearance and export are not certified.
Orthographic camera declarations require independent verification evidence.
Similarity checks do not certify identity, semantic parts or camera calibration.
Verified camera declarations are producer assumptions backed by existing hashed evidence, not calibration performed by this engine.
